# 4.26 Twenty-sixth assembly district.
All of the following territory in Sheboygan County constitutes the 26th assembly district:
(1) The town of Wilson.
(2) That part of the town of Sheboygan comprising U.S. census tract 100, blocks 2004, 2005, 2009, and 2010; and tract 202, blocks 1001, 1002, 1003, 1005, 1010, 1011, 1012, 1020, and 1032; and tract 300, blocks 1001, 1002, 1003, 1006, 1008, 3001, 3014, 3015, 3016, 3017, 4001, 4003, 4006, 4007, 4008, 4010, 4011, 4016, 4021, 4026, 4027, 4028, 4030, and 4031; and tract 400, blocks 1020, 1022, 1025, 1027, 1028, 1030, 1032, 1045, 1046, 1047, 1048, 1051, 1053, 2022, 2023, 2028, 2029, 2030, 2033, 2037, 2053, 2055, 2056, 2057, 2058, 2059, 2061, 2063, 2069, 2070, 2071, 2073, 2074, 2075, 2076, 2077, 2078, 2079, 2083, 2084, 2094, 2096, and 2099; and tract 900, blocks 3003, 3004, 3005, 3009, 3016, 3019, 3020, 3021, 3022, 3023, 3025, 3026, 3040, 3041, 3048, 3049, 3051, 3053, 3056, 3057, 3058, 3059, 3098, and 3100; and tract 1000, blocks 2006 and 2007; and tract 10700, blocks 1001, 1002, 1003, 1004, 1005, 1006, 1007, 1008, 1009, 1010, 1011, 1012, 1013, 1014, 1015, 1016, 1019, 1020, 1021, 1022, 1023, 1024, 1029, 1031, 1032, 1033, 1035, 1037, 1038, 1039, 1043, 1045, 1046, 1047, 1048, 1051, 1052, 1053, 1055, 1056, 1057, 1058, 1060, 1061, 1062, 1063, 1066, 1067, 1068, 1069, 1071, 1074, 1075, 2000, 2001, 2006, 2008, 2011, 2012, 2108, 2109, 2110, 3000, 3001, 3002, 3005, 3006, 3007, 3008, 3009, 3010, 3014, 3015, 3016, 3017, 3018, 3019, 3020, 3021, 3022, 3023, 3024, 3025, 3026, 3027, 3028, and 3029.
(3) The city of Sheboygan.
